title: Encrypted Bridge onboarding flow and compact screenshot library
creator: Clara Nguyen
description: Design a compact, mobile-friendly set of onboarding microflows, sequence diagrams, and product screenshots for the Encrypted Bridge (private/VPC) path that covers initial network provisioning, encrypted tunnel setup, and in-place upgrade UI. Deliverables include a screenshot library (desktop + narrow-width), annotated sequence diagrams for engineers, and a short microcopy pack for inline help.

design_assets: Figma component page - Compact UI tokens: https://www.figma.com/file/EncryptedBridge/ENBRIDGE-components
decisions: Use a 4-step compact onboarding microflow (Network selection -> Key exchange -> Tunnel verification -> Finalize + Upgrade) to reduce cognitive load.
Prefer in-line compact modal over full-screen wizard for first-run setup in Console to minimize context switching.
Use pill progress indicator (4 pills) instead of numeric stepper to save vertical space on narrow viewports.
Include an explicit retry action on key-exchange failure and surface firewall port guidance inline rather than in a separate doc.
Keep all microcopy under 90 characters per card for narrow screenshots; provide an optional expanded help panel for technical details.
next_steps: Finalize microcopy pack and hand off to Docs for short-form inline help (owner: Marco).
Create final screenshot exports in light/dark theme and upload to release assets (owner: Clara).
Open PR with updated screenshot references in private-deploy quickstart docs (owner: Docs Team).
Work with Frontend to implement pill progress and compact modal; track as ENG-19834 dependency.
Schedule stakeholder review with Security (Mar 16) to confirm KMS/HSM copy accuracy.
review_feedback: Priya Desai (Infra Eng): Please call out UDP 4500 and ESP/UDP 500 in the install checklist — adding a small network troubleshooting panel would reduce support tickets.
Rico Thompson (Design Lead): Visual hierarchy looks good; reduce label density on the tunnel verification card and emphasize success state with a green ring.
Sasha Holt (QA): Mobile exports need a 2px larger tap target for the 'Retry' CTA on small devices.
